_comment: Bards guild layer for 3s. Like Necromancers, this guild has NO private MIP tag - vitals ride the mud-wide FFF composite feed (A=hp C=sp E=gp1 G=gp2). Maxes self-calibrate from peak observed value. Cascade rule REPLACE (character file wins).

Pools (all four user-confirmed): HP, SP, GP1 = Karma, GP2 = Voice. Karma caps at 802 (wire F~802) and is spent on songs. Voice drifts 92-105 and is NOT a percent - it must never be clamped to 100 the way the changeling E-field is.

AAA (the bard ability feed: bard_<ability> then bard_perform/bard_cast/bard_ceased_song) is deliberately NOT registered. It carries nothing the display needs - J is authoritative for the song being performed and I for the active buffs - and client.py already suppresses AAA from the 'mip?' unknown-tag line, so registering it would buy nothing.

bard_maintain: all eight buffs must stay up at all times (user rule). The client casts for them automatically - see katmud_lib/bard.py for the wire evidence behind the token map. Sends go through the normal non-manual send_line path, so a tripped deadman silently blocks them and any keypress releases it.
Command strings are user-confirmed. 'cast refresh' is also wire-confirmed (line 983 of logs/3s bards.log tops up all three songs at once).
ab (anticipate blows), AB (avoid blows) and RF (righteous fury) carry no counter and never wear off, so they are displayed but never maintained. ab/AB are mutually exclusive and differ only by case.
